verdict.rationale: Gladia documents an asynchronous transcription API, so a completion or failure webhook is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions registrable callbacks or webhooks for job completion or failure. The Zapier, Make and n8n integrations are third-party automation tools, not first-party outbound HTTP callbacks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, a webhook or callback fires when a job completes or fails, so nothing in my system has to poll
